title: F34 · the_taunt · "In Our Time..."
lines: n
In our time, we ground the spices by hand.
"In our time, we ground the spices by hand."
n
Too much salt. Too little. The curtains. The children's manners.
n
For three days she has smiled and said nothing.
n
She is one sentence away from saying something she cannot take back.
n
Dadi called the aunt to sit with her. And told her a story about a devotee who would only bow to one half.
n
He lost all his flesh, Dadi said sweetly, for not honouring the woman of the house.
"He lost all his flesh," Dadi said sweetly, "for not honouring the woman of the house."
n
The aunt was quiet for a whole minute. A record.
n
Then she tasted the dal again.
Give me the recipe, she said.
"Give me the recipe," she said.
n
Honour the one who holds the house. That is sadhana.
n
